about: The str_replace verb through file application (TEXT-1, TEXT-6, TEXT-12), moved from scalar_declarative_text_replace.rs at 144fc5559, whose tests compared the saved bytes, the run's handler counts as the report's handler rows name them (SPEC_PATH, NAME, COUNT), and each issue at the fields they read. The authored benchmark reproduces its expected bytes, and the negative one is refused before any input exists. A value without a match is kept, an empty result stays text, an empty match takes the replacement literally, a catastrophic pattern without a match scans in linear time and leaves the value unchanged (TEXT-12), and a missing source gives missing or the declared literal, counted at the verb's missing path (COLUMN-14). A non-string source and an unknown one are refused at the source. Nested case branches and row templates bind the same operation. The bespoke specifications, JSON documents in the test, are written as the same YAML documents, and each stages only the files it reads, as the test's copy of schema-str-replace held them. No engine output supplied these values.
